full_judgment: 7. Defendant Nos. 77(Ka)-77(Cha) 78/79 and 80(Ka) to 80(Ga) entered appearance in the suit and also prayed for saham. The case of these defendants is that Asaruddin became owner of his share by the registered kabuliyat dated 25-3-1912, who died leaving behind one son Montazuddin and daughter Johura Bibi, and father Sokemuddin; that Johura died leaving behind husband Johuruddin, sons being A. Aziz, Kanchan Ali and A. Latif; that A Latif died leaving behind the defendant Nos. 77(Ka)- to 77(Cha)/78/79 and 80(Ka) to 80(Ga) as legal heirs who got 58 decimals of land out of which 37 decimals of land had been wrongly recorded in the name of the defendant No.21.
